title: Document & Image QA System
description: Build a multimodal question-answering system that answers questions about documents containing text, images/figures, and tables — with per-answer provenance (page/region citations) and a fixed evaluation set with human-graded answers.
learningObjectives: Represent documents as multimodal elements (text blocks, figures, tables)
Combine image understanding with text retrieval for grounded answers
Cite page/region provenance for every answer
Grade answer quality with a documented rubric on a fixed set

milestones.title: Document structuring
milestones.objective: Parse sample documents into typed elements (blocks/figures/tables) with regions.

milestones.title: Multimodal retrieval
milestones.objective: Implement retrieval over text and image embeddings (e.g. CLIP-style) with a schema that keeps provenance.
milestones.expectedOutput: Retrieval returns elements with page/region IDs.

milestones.title: Answer generation + provenance
milestones.objective: Generate answers from retrieved multimodal context, obligated to cite element IDs.
milestones.expectedOutput: Answer schema with citations; refusal on insufficient support.

milestones.title: Graded evaluation set
milestones.objective: Hand-grade at least 15 answers on a three-level rubric; record inter-run consistency.
milestones.expectedOutput: Graded table with score distribution and failure causes.

categories.minimumExpectation: End-to-end answer with citations on sample docs

categories.excellentExpectation: Unanswerable questions detected and refused consistently
CI smoke test on tiny fixture document

architecture: parse → structure → embed (text+image) → retrieve → answer with citations
constraints: No fabricated provenance: citation IDs must exist
hints: Tables are where most systems fail; handle them as first-class elements rather than flattening to text
